newsitem.title: USA: U.S. leading indicators rise 0.1 pct in November.
newsitem.headline: U.S. leading indicators rise 0.1 pct in November.

text.p: A key guage of economic activity inched higher in November, the Conference Board said on Monday, suggesting the expansion will continue in the months ahead.
The Index of Leading Indicators, which is designed to forecast economic trends six to nine months down the road, rose 0.1 percent in the month after holding steady in October.
